change_summary: Changed BLOCK_N from 16 to 8 inside the kernel body, halving the accumulator size (128x16=2048 → 128x8=1024 fp32 elements) to reduce register pressure from 160 to ~80-100 registers/thread and improve occupancy from 18.75% to ~37%+. Grid updated to (131072, 1, 1) to match the doubled number of N-tiles.
